subject: food-technology
title: The Eatwell Plate
welcome_lead: The plate that shows what a balanced diet looks like.
meta_desc: KS3 food: Eatwell guide food groups and proportions.
final_note: Balance from the Eatwell plate keeps you healthy.

concepts.def: UK plate showing balanced food groups.
Energy foods — bread, pasta, rice, potato.
5 a day for vitamins and fibre.

walkthroughs.body_html: The Eatwell Guide shows 5 main food groups. The biggest sections are fruit and vegetables and starchy carbohydrates — both about a third of your food.
Protein foods (meat, fish, eggs, beans) and dairy alternatives each fill roughly an eighth of the plate. They build and repair your body.
Tiny amounts of oils and spreads. Cakes, sweets and crisps sit outside the plate — eat occasionally only. Drink 6-8 glasses of water a day.
